item.title: Second Half Time
item.description: A quick update of whats going on, wait what really is going on huh. weeks, maybe even months pass without posting anything. Honestly I also don’t know what to say, much/not much has been going on in life, just the same old work-home routine. Well I started reading a book, Atomic Habits, maybe that’s something. My thoughts on the book so far, great opening at each level, i honestly thought the book will be much more heavy on the mind in terms of the words and school of thought but now i can see why its like a fun favourite.
